The '''Jedi Grand Council''' was the governing body of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order's]] [[Jedi Lord]]s during the [[New Sith Wars]].

==Overview==
Formed apart from the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] during the [[New Sith Wars]], the Jedi Grand Council was an alternate governing body within the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and existed outside the jurisdiction of the High Council. Composed of those Jedi who had taken up the title of [[Jedi Lord|Lord]] in areas of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] which they protected through the construction of feudal kingdoms and fiefdoms, the Grand Council made decisions on behalf of the collected group of Lords.<ref name="TEGTW" />

When the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]] formed during the final decade of the war, the Grand Council came together for a final meeting and declared unanimous support for the [[Army of Light/Legends|Army of Light]], the brainchild of [[Hoth (Jedi Lord)|Lord Hoth]] in response to the High Council's ineffectiveness. The decision placed all feudal holdings and their vassals under the command of Hoth as he chased the Brotherhood across the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and drove them to their final confrontation during the [[Ruusan campaign]]. The citizens who opposed the conception of the Jedi Lords were appalled by the Council's decision to unite them. The Council was disbanded after the end of the War during the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformations]] which completely restructured both the Jedi Order and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TEGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Grand Council was first introduced into [[Star Wars]] Expanded Universe, now [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]], in the [[2012]] publication of ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''.
